title: DNA Clean and Concentrator Protocol
author: Zymo Research

In a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube, add 2-7 volumes of DNA Binding Buffer to each volume of DNA sample (see table below). Mix briefly by vortexing. a For efficient recovery of genomic or large DNA (> 20 kb to > 200 kb), use the Genomic DNA Clean & Concentrator™ (Cat. Nos. D4010, D4011). 1 For ssDNA purification, see Appendix A

steps.title: Load sample onto column
steps.instruction: Transfer the mixture to a Zymo‑Spin™ Column placed in a collection tube; the column holds up to 800 µl, so if the sample volume exceeds this, load and spin the column repeatedly until all sample has passed through.

steps.title: Centrifuge and discard flow‑through
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column for 30 seconds, then discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: First wash
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl DNA Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge for 30 seconds (wash 1 of 2).

steps.title: Second wash
steps.instruction: Add another 200 µl DNA Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge for 30 seconds (wash 2 of 2).

steps.title: Add elution buffer
steps.instruction: Add at least 6 µl DNA Elution Buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8.5, 0.1 mM EDTA) **or** water (pH > 6.0) directly onto the column matrix and incubate at room temperature for 1 minute. For DNA >6 kb, the 1‑minute incubation may improve yield; for DNA >10 kb, elution can be enhanced by using pre‑warmed (60‑70 °C) DNA Elution Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add ≥ 6 µl Elution Buffer or water to the column matrix.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 minute (longer incubation may help large fragments).
Optional: for fragments >10 kb, pre‑warm Elution Buffer to 60‑70 °C before adding.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube and centrifuge for 30 seconds to collect the eluate; the ultra‑pure DNA is now ready for use.
